review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines only one new object, `unitSection`, which is a reducible abbreviation for the `.1` of `L.one (𝟙 _)` for the project's own `RelativeGroupLaw`. I found no Mathlib counterpart for it. The only comparable Mathlib notion is `GrpObj`'s unit, which is a different representation. `RelativeGroupLaw` and `SchemeHomOver` come from the project's Definitions files, not from this file. `eq_one_of_mul_self`, `inv_one`, `nsmulPt_one`, `pushPt_one_of_hom`, `unitSection_comp`, `factorsThrough_unitSection_iff` and `topologicalKrullDim_fibre_eq` are theorems, so they fall under the standalone-theorem exclusion. `main` and `solution` are the end-result theorems. Other project files define `unitSection` with the same body, for example `S_CerednikDrinfeld_QM_nonempty_fakeEllipticCurve_one_of_act_of_algHom_matrix_of_trace_of_charZero.lean:54`. That is duplication inside the project, not a competing version of a Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core concept, so I did not report it. I did not check how `RelativeGroupLaw` relates to Mathlib's group objects, because the definition is not in this file. I am fairly confident that nothing in this file qualifies under this rubric.
